spirit:modelParameter.spirit:name: DAC_FSADJ_I
spirit:modelParameter.spirit:description: I-channel full-scale adjust (IRSET register, 0..63). Sets ~8.7..31.7 mA full-scale current. Default 32 = mid-code (~20 mA).
